root_cause.text: The nf_tables flowtable error cleanup path released the flowtable structure without waiting for an RCU grace period, enabling concurrent packet processing or netlink operations to access freed memory through registered hooks.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `synchronize_rcu()` in the `err_flowtable_hooks` error path of `nf_tables_newflowtable`, addressing the KASAN-reported use-after-free where "a hook that already refers to this flowtable can be already registered" during error handling.

intent_record.intent_summary: Prevents use-after-free race conditions in nf_tables flowtable creation error paths by enforcing RCU synchronization prior to resource destruction.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to synchronize_rcu() immediately before nft_trans_destroy(trans) within the err_flowtable_hooks error handling block.
intent_record.how: Blocks execution until all pre-existing RCU read-side critical sections complete, ensuring safe deallocation of flowtable transaction resources without risking use-after-free errors from concurrent readers.
